thread:
alex: evening handback — i'm taking primary for the next 3h. quick run-down: incident bot fired for multiple 5xx from inference pool 'gpu-pool-3' around 20:12 UTC. customer impact looks limited but rising (approx ~3% of requests see 5xx / degraded latency). tagging jamal as secondary. :wave:

incident-bot: Pager triggered: INFR-502 - kv-cache thrash detected on gpu-pool-3 (20:12 UTC) responders: oncall-primary, oncall-secondary

jamal: noted. do we have a hotfix or quick fallback route? any recent deploys?

alex: no deploys in last 2 hours. telemetry shows a spike in long-seq requests to redwood-13b-512 that blows past kv-cache limits. if this stays >5% we should scale pool and enable model fallback to redwood-7b-short for non-critical routes.

sylvia: quick checklist from runbook: 1) confirm error rate on /v1/generate 2) enable fallback routing 3) scale pool by +2 nodes 4) watch latency SLOs. runbooks: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kvcache-thrash and https://redwood.internal/runbooks/fallback-routing

maria: support ticket #7834 showing 2 enterprise customers reported truncation and 504s, both on EU region. flagging for outreach if we hit >1% enterprise errors.

alex: commands i'm running now (watching logs + scaling):
```bash
# tail recent error spikes
kubectl -n inference logs -l pool=gpu-pool-3 --since=15m | grep "KV cache" -n

# scale up pool quickly
infractl pools scale gpu-pool-3 --add 2 --priority emergency

# enable fallback routing for low-tier routes
infractl routing set --pool gpu-pool-3 --fallback redwood-7b-short --threshold 0.02
```

jamal: i can hold SRE runbook steps if we need to rollback quantization or temporarily pin model versions. quick pointer: if scaling doesn't reduce 5xx in 5m, do a canary traffic shift to gpu-pool-4 (same zone) then failover regionally. runbook snippet: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pool-failover

incident-bot: Note: automated fallback attempted at 20:18 UTC and succeeded for ~12% of eligible requests.

alex: initial mitigation: scaled pool + enabled fallback. error rate dropped from 3.2% to 1.1% over 6 minutes. still watching. next steps: keep scaling step for 10m window, monitor cost/latency, and prepare rollback plan.

sylvia: quick remediation cheatsheet (copy to handoff):
- If errors >2% persist: add +2 nodes and increase KV-memory by 10% (infra ticket template: INFRA-KV-INC).
- If fallback triggers >20%: reduce fallback threshold and notify product-owner.
- If latency >500ms P95: enable short-sequence model for tail requests only (route by seq_len > 512).
- Emergency contact: #oncall-escalation, pager duty: EscalationPolicy-Primary

maria: support will draft proactive messages for affected customers if we breach 1% enterprise errors. i have the template ready: https://redwood.internal/templates/customer-impact-comms.md

alex: putting this in the handback notes:
- primary: Alex Rivera (me)
- secondary: Jamal Chen
- current status: mitigated -> errors 1.1%, monitoring
- runbooks referenced: /runbooks/kvcache-thrash, /runbooks/fallback-routing, /runbooks/pool-failover
- manual commands run: infractl scale, routing set (see commands above)
- tickets: #7834 linked to EU customers
- follow-up: check KV memory pressure graphs in Grafana (dash: infra/kvcache) and decide by 21:00 UTC if we keep nodes or scale down.

jamal: i'll keep an eye on failover metrics and temp-alerts. if you want, i can take primary when you rotate at 21:00 UTC.

alex: thanks — please note a couple of quick runbook links to paste in handoff: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kvcache-thrash#quick-fixes and https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pool-scaling#emergency-scaling  :thumbsup:

opsbot: Reminder: add playbook tag 'evening-handback' to incident log and attach perf graphs within 1h.

alex: adding final note for whoever picks this up: watch for correlated spike in long-context requests from the synthetic traffic generator (synth-load-3). if it reappears, isolate client-id and add rate-limit rule: `rate-limit client synth-load-3 10r/s`

maria: thanks team — i'll ping customers if needed and update ticket #7834. good handoff when you swap. :white_check_mark:

alex: handback complete. leaving monitoring alerts at standard sensitivity. reach me on pager if it resurfaces.
